title: Pages — the shell, round 10: pinned focus, the create dialog, one band for Pages and Projects

steps.path: Top bar → a pinned page's button
steps.headline: A pinned button opens its page edge to edge: no panel, the button lit, the Pages icon quiet.
steps.changed: From your note: a pinned page shows full screen, framed, with no side bar. Its button in the band reads as the selected one; a second press returns to chat. While any page view is open the chat's keyboard shortcuts (Shift+Space, Shift+Tab, Ctrl+`, the Shift-hold switcher, arrow scrolling) no longer fire; Esc and zoom still do.
steps.notice: The page gets the whole width; the band still offers Settings, Pages, Projects and the other pinned pages.
steps.risk: Keys typed inside the page never reached the app before either; the change is only for keys pressed with the page view up but nothing inside it focused.

steps.path: A focused page → the Pages icon
steps.headline: From a focused page, the Pages icon brings the panel back with that page still open.
steps.changed: Pages is lit again, the pinned button goes quiet, and the panel returns beside the page — no reload, the page keeps whatever it was doing.
steps.notice: Pages and the pinned buttons are two ways to hold the same page: with the list, or without.

steps.path: The band across the top of the page view
steps.headline: The pinned pages sit in the band after Projects, as they do in the chat's header.
steps.changed: Kept in the header (your call) and added to the page view's band, so the band's left cluster is now the same set the chat shows: Settings, Pages, Projects, then the pinned pages.
steps.notice: The band no longer loses the pinned shortcuts when you are among your pages.
steps.risk: Up to four pinned pages; the cluster grows by one icon each.

steps.headline: Create a page opens the new-conversation dialog: project folder, model, skip permissions.
steps.changed: From your note: instead of starting a conversation straight away, a popup with the app's own new-session form. Create Session starts the conversation with the page-builder command already typed in, and leaves the page view.
steps.notice: The same form the session menu and the welcome screen use, in the app's dialog shell; Manage projects… in the folder list goes to Projects.
steps.risk: The command waits in the composer, not sent, so you add what the page should do and press Enter.

steps.path: Manage pages → the pencil on a card
steps.headline: Editing a page opens the same dialog, titled for the page, starting in the page's own project.
steps.changed: Edit used to jump straight into a conversation; now it asks the same folder-and-model question. A project page starts in its project so the builder finds the page's folder; a personal page starts in the saved default.
steps.notice: One dialog for creating and for editing; only the title and the pre-typed command differ.

steps.headline: Projects wears the same band and framed pane as the page view; the two screens now match.
steps.changed: From your note: the same band — Settings, Pages, Projects (lit), the pinned pages on the left; the title centred; Back to chat · Esc and the window buttons on the right — and the content in a rounded, inset pane. Projects' old title row with its own Pages button and Esc · Back to chat is gone; nothing inside the pane changed.
steps.notice: Switching between Pages and Projects keeps the band in place; only the pane and the lit icon change.
steps.risk: On a phone the pane's inset costs ten pixels a side; the narrow behaviour of the band is still the open question from round 9.
